LESSON: STORIES OF PROPHETS:

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: PILLARS OF IMAN
Topic 3.1: Stories of Prophets:

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Stories of Prophets:. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How did the selected prophets demonstrate Iman in Allah (S.W.T.)?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the lessons learnt from the stories of the prophets for character development
2. appreciate the selected prophets as role models

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: STORIES OF PROPHETS:
This lesson teaches Stories of Prophets: for Grade 6 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. explain the lessons learnt from the stories of the prophets for character development
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. appreciate the selected prophets as role models
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Stories of Prophets: using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Stories of Prophets: above.
2. Explain Stories of Prophets: to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Stories of Prophets:.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Stories of Prophets: with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Stories of Prophets: important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How did the selected prophets demonstrate Iman in Allah (S.W.T.)?
2. What virtues are derived from prophets Ibrahim (A.S.) and Musa (A.S.)’s stories?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain the lessons learnt from the stories of the prophets for character development
2. appreciate the selected prophets as role models

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
